quarterly_data.quarter: SoftBank press release: Issuance of Foreign Currency-Denominated Senior Notes (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: SoftBank Group priced USD- and EUR-denominated Senior Notes with an aggregate principal of approximately USD 11.1 billion (JPY 1,763.2 billion equivalent): USD 10 billion of USD notes (USD 1,000 million due 2030 at 8.625%, USD 4,500 million due 2032 at 9.250%, USD 4,500 million due 2034 at 9.750%) and EUR 1 billion of EUR notes (EUR 500 million due 2030 at 7.125%, EUR 500 million due 2032 at 8.000%); expected issue date September 29, 2026; rated BB+ by S&P Global Ratings Japan and Fitch Ratings Japan. Use of proceeds: funding the USD 10 billion payment for the third and final tranche of the USD 30 billion follow-on investments in OpenAI Group PBC entered into in February 2026 (expected to close on October 1, 2026) and general corporate purposes. Concurrently SoftBank expects to cancel the remaining USD 10 billion of undrawn capacity under the USD 40 billion Bridge Facility Agreement entered into in March 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Notes approx. USD 11.1 billion (USD 10 billion + EUR 1 billion); coupons 8.625%-9.750% (USD), 7.125%-8.000% (EUR); funds USD 10 billion final tranche of USD 30 billion OpenAI follow-on investment; USD 10 billion of USD 40 billion Bridge Facility to be cancelled
